name: tool_info
summary:
The long help, in small steps: {} lists the shared topics, {tool} a tool's topics, {tool, topic} or {topic} one topic and its subtopics, {tool, topic, subtopic} the detail.
Answered without the game. Errors carry see: {tool, topic} naming the node that explains them.

help.text: tool_info answers one help node per call, each under 1.5 KB. Start with {tool: "<name>"} for any tool, or {} for the topics every tool shares. A tool that takes fields also answers reply_keys: its main reply keys, the names fields and omit take.

levels.summary: The three levels and how to name a node.
levels.text: Level 1 is a tool ({tool}) or a shared topic ({topic}). Level 2 is a topic of that tool ({tool, topic}); a tool's topic may also name a shared topic. Level 3 is a subtopic ({tool, topic, subtopic} or {topic, subtopic}). Each reply lists the next level's names with one line each. A name that matches nothing is refused (help_not_found) with the names it knows or the nearest ones; subtopic without topic is refused (invalid_argument).

pointers.summary: What (see X) and see in an error mean.
pointers.text: In an argument's description, (see positions) means tool_info {topic: "positions"}, and (see shaping/fields) means tool_info {topic: "shaping", subtopic: "fields"}. (topic X) names topic X of the same tool. An error's see {tool, topic, subtopic} is the node that explains it: pass it to tool_info as it is.

tool.description: A tool's name: its help and topics.

topic.description: A topic of that tool, or a shared topic when tool is left out.
